title: Canonical derived truncations preserve coproducts
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring and X a scheme. Put A=Mod(Λ_X), the category of module objects over its pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and use its ordinary derived category [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. For any type I in the site/coefficient indexing universe, any family K_i in D(A), and any colimit cofan c for this family, the image of c under τ≥r ∘ τ≤q is a colimit cofan for all integers q,r. These are the canonical standard truncations [def-kun-truncations]. No constructibility or boundedness assumption is made.

proof.text: The module-object category is Grothendieck abelian; its small coproducts exist and are exact. Its derived category has coproducts and the homology functors preserve them.

For upper truncation T=τ≤q and any family, test its canonical coproduct comparison on H^n. If n≤q, naturality of T→id identifies the comparison with the ordinary homology coproduct comparison after composing with isomorphisms. The truncation triangle makes H^n(T M)→H^n(M) invertible. If n>q, homology preservation identifies the source with a coproduct of zero objects, while the target has zero homology by the truncation bound. Thus every cohomology map is invertible and so is the comparison.

For lower truncation τ≥r, a coproduct of objects in D≥r remains there, since homology preserves coproducts. The universal property of M→τ≥r M constructs the inverse of the coproduct comparison. Use the already proved private generic theorem CondensedRing.truncGE_preservesCoproducts in EllAdicProperLocalizingCoproducts, whose proof is exactly this argument. Compose the two preservation statements and apply them to c. The same universal properties cover I empty and r>q.

theorem derivedTruncation_coproducts
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type (u + 1))
    (K : I → DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects Λ X)) (c : Cofan K)
    (hc : IsColimit c) (q r : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE q) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE r).mapCocone c))
